records.text: Ridge Studio churned, flagging for the pipeline review

records.subject: Your Wrenfield subscription has been canceled
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

This confirms the cancellation of your Wrenfield plan. Sorry to see Ridge Studio go -- if there's feedback on what didn't work, I'd genuinely like to hear it.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Re: Picking back up with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

No problem at all -- thanks for letting me know. I'm here when the timing's better.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Re: Picking back up with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Priya,

Thanks for checking in. We're still interested, just hadn't carved out the time yet.

Mateo

records.subject: Picking back up with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

A lot of teams stall right at inviting their first teammate. If that's where things got stuck, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Created first project on day 0 (signup) and attended the onboarding call as scheduled [calendar:e38bd30c], so engagement is real; but no invites, no key milestone, no reply to welcome email [email:d0fe1fa8], no tickets, and 7 days of silence since project creation with 8 days left.

draft.subject: Following up on yesterday's call
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for making time yesterday — good to walk through Ridge Studio's setup with you. You've got your first project going, which is the main thing: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

Whenever you're ready to bring the rest of the studio in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want me to help you get that first batch of invites out this week? Just reply and I'll walk through it with you.

Best,
Priya
